set.body:
Objective

Introduce one private evidence_task IR whose partial materializations include the already certified effect-form task.

Scope and deliverables

- Represent left and right relation families and all four complete space identities.
- Represent the experimental boundary as open or closed by an axis-bound H.
- Represent the neural boundary as closed by an identified bridge or query, or open through an identified measurement frame and explicit edge request.
- Record ordered partition products, axis-labelled normalization, edge transforms, reduction order, requested materialization, completeness, and source use.
- Make compile_effect_task a conservative compatibility constructor for open experimental and closed neural boundaries.
- Canonically serialize semantics so unchanged effect-form calls retain their scientific identities.
- Keep storage, tiling, worker count, and route selection outside scientific identity.

Acceptance evidence

- Existing effect-task, source-preflight, result, receipt, and installed-workflow tests pass without reinterpretation.
- Compatibility compilation produces the same values, capabilities, pre-read failures, and scientific plan hashes as the certified effect-form route.
- Reversing every typed side produces the exact transposed task.
- Axis and boundary mismatches fail before source reads.
- No measurement-form numerical execution is required yet.

Ownership boundary

Own compiler/task IR and identity serialization. Do not alter public constructors or result classes except internal compatibility adapters required by the IR.

Deferred non-goals

No all-purpose tensor DSL, engine registry, workflow orchestration, learned operations, or public evidence_task object.
set.title: Epic 2: Generalize the private compiler to a boundary-typed evidence task
